scope: One official state guidance source family; factual coding only

claims.summary: ODE maintains a current web-based version of its generative-AI guidance.
The guidance recommends district-level planning and clear local policy processes for AI use.
The guidance identifies families and communities as participants in AI planning and evaluation.
claims.source_anchor: Guiding Principles: Continuous Evaluation, Future Readiness, and Community Partnership

claims.summary: The guidance directs district leaders to consider staff and student privacy in school settings.
The guidance addresses equitable access, including disability, multilingual, device, and connectivity considerations.
claims.source_anchor: Guiding Principles: Equity and Access for All Learners

claims.summary: ODE provides a separate resource for developing local policies and protocols for generative AI.
